items.label: thm:padding

role.construction: Fully paid data-free prefix with literal coarse-charge CutIneq for arbitrary payloads and full M* limits for linear-time families. items.title: Adaptive forest bound

items.evidence: adaptive-coding/contracts.json; scoped semantic review reports and final compiled-source acceptance are recorded separately.
scope_limits: Full-cube bank bijections; whole-column forward window sigma; full-cube recovery of each nonempty row interval with reachable-state range at most 2^s, s real nonnegative.

Public history-dependent Boolean queries, declared support at most two stored coordinates; only actual correct-input executions must halt and satisfy leafwise coordinate forest and projected row degree Delta.
Original raw-row side information, all-inputs-in-F correctness, arbitrary finite normalized input law including zero masses, helper-selected bank/states/strategy/decoders.

items.label: cor:adaptive-coded-rate
items.title: Near-full answer cost
items.role: Makes the finite bound useful uniformly in entry width and describes exactly which information budgets rule out fractional answer savings.
items.evidence: adaptive-coding/contracts.json; scoped semantic review reports and final compiled-source acceptance are recorded separately.
scope_limits: Actual adaptive forest law family, b(d)>0 at positive d, fixed degree Delta.
Qualitative: sigma(d)/d tends to zero and (s+Dtot)/P tends to zero.
Quantitative: sigma fixed, s<=As*W, Dtot<=Ad*W, fixed nonnegative As,Ad.

items.label: thm:shear-recovery
items.title: Recovery across every pair of half-row sets
items.role: Rules out making all interval-recovery states sublinear in expectation by independently chosen row orders and separate within-row bijections, even under randomized helper selection, when fixed eta>0,Delta and input deficit plus helper mutual information is sublinear.
items.evidence: adaptive-coding/contracts.json; scoped semantic review reports and final compiled-source acceptance are recorded separately.
scope_limits: Binary simple bipartite incidence L on m+m rows, row/column degree<=Delta, outside-neighbor expansion eta for sets of at most m vertices, 0<eta<=1.
Arbitrary finite input law on m+m rows of W bits. Independently chosen raw and stored half sets, each of cardinality m.

Arbitrary finite joint input/helper law, with no determinism premise. Helper selects both half sets, separate within-row raw and stored bijections, and arbitrary nonlinear finite-range states and decoders; branch budget s(z) bounds both reachable state ranges throughout that branch.

items.label: thm:cheap-shear
items.title: Cheap encoding with expensive interval recovery
items.role: Shows that cheap native encoding, bounded inverse incidence and zero forward column radius do not force small interval-recovery states. Supplies a paid workspace primitive, not a transpose decoder or complete-exchange saving.
items.evidence: adaptive-coding/contracts.json; scoped semantic review reports and final compiled-source acceptance are recorded separately.
scope_limits: Existential fixed rational family, positive expansion eta<=1, fixed degree Delta and runtime constant C; all witnesses precede dimension.
Every even canonical dimension d=2m>=2, W=d*entryBits d and P=d*W; arbitrary raw input of length P.
Original deterministic finite-state multitape model; blank initial work tapes, read-only raw input and append-only raw output.
